_doc: How far a day's walk goes (src/player/core/lifecycle.js, movement.js; systems/infrastructure.js getPlayerHexDays). Travel is counted in DAYS PER HEX: crossing one hex of open land takes three quarters of a day, a forest a whole day, a mountain three. The day's movement budget (stamina plus every bonus, after starvation, mood and wounds, times dayScale) is the day; a hex costs its days times the full, unimpaired day (player._dayPace), divided by the travel speed. A hex longer than what is left of the day is crossed over several days: the traveller camps on the way and arrives when it is done (player.crossing).
_hexDays: Days to cross one hex off the road, by terrain id ('default' for anything not listed).
_floorDays: However fast the traveller (horse, technology, endurance, scouts...), crossing this terrain off the road never takes less than this many days. A road through it uses the road's figure instead.
_roads: Days per hex on a road, whatever the ground under it. dirt: a dirt road the player built; stone: a paved road the player built (and a bridge); track / road / highway: the world's road tiers (world/transport.js; a rutted road is slower by its rutted factor, a ruined one is no road at all). defaultWorldRoad: a generated road with no tier recorded.
_roadTerrain: A road through rough ground is a little slower: the road's days times this, by terrain id.
_roadExtraDays: Days added per point of a road's extra (world/transport.js: spring mud +1, a pass closed by snow +3).
_riverFordDays: Days added for fording a river where there is no bridge (Bridge Construction and a Grand Bridge cut it; a road's ford or ferry costs half as much).
_speed: Bonuses (a riding horse, technology, housing, scouts, Endurance) only shave a little off: speed = 1 + min(cap, bonusWeight x bonus / stamina). A hex's days are divided by the speed (floors above still hold off the road).
_crossingNames: What the camp notices call a long crossing, by terrain id.
